ZSPD.notes: Rebuilt 26-27 Nov 2026 (user decisions). At Pudong FASCO (the airport's own ground service agency) provides the ground services; the agents pass FASCO's CNY tariff on and add their own fees. Airport section = airport charges only, common to every handler at CNY 6.7 per USD: landing & take-off 2,420; parking 330 per day (GL7T 51.13 USD per Fastransit); passenger service charge 70 and security check 12 per pax, arriving and departing; follow-me 432 per time x 2; night flight surcharge 300 per hour 21:00-08:00 (surcharge row, 1 hour). Handler section, each handler at its own unit price: Handling Fee = basic ground handling as billed (FASCO 5,800, 50 t and above 6,100; Fastransit has no such line, its handling service charge is used); FBO service fee per movement x 2 (FASCO international: up to 25 t 23,800, 26-50 t 28,800, 51 t and above 33,800; ferry flights 50% off); tow truck, mooring, ramp shuttle (first one per inbound / outbound free; default 1, raise the qty) and GPU per hour. HY converts CNY at about 6.497, so its third-party lines run about 3% above the others. Disbursement: HY 7% on all airport and third-party lines; Far East 7% on third-party charges; Cloud Jet 8% on third-party items; Fastransit 6% on its airport and third-party section; FASCO none. Cloud Jet quotes FBO international CNY 28,800 for G450 / G550 / G7000 (quantity 1, In/Out) and no mooring or GPU. Far East quotes landing permit & slot 100 per sector (200 per flight) and crew transport 120 per trip. Fastransit GLEX quote: luggage x 4, belt x 2. FASCO (HANDLER): direct, no agent (permit, CIQ declaration and agent arranged separately). UNIVERSAL: no document; FASCO tariff values in the handler rows, own handling fee unknown; permit 515, communication 30, lavatory 51, water 60 and night / weekend 264 from the earlier entry. CAAC en-route, terminal navigation and compensation fees are in no quote.
